req.title: Login form GET
req.statement: The system shall serve a login form at GET /auth/login.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the login form should be served at GET /auth/login with an HTTP 2xx response. Tests are designed to verify this behavior under normal, boundary, and erroneous conditions.

tests.name: test_login_form_get_positive
preconditions: The Flask application is running in test mode.
expected: The response contains the login form HTML.
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/auth/login')
assert response.status_code == 200
assert b'<form' in response.data
assert b'name="username"' in response.data
assert b'name="password"' in response.data

tests.name: test_login_form_get_negative
preconditions: The Flask application is running in test mode.
actions: Send a POST request to /auth/login with invalid data.
expected: Receive an HTTP 405 response indicating method not allowed.
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()
response = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'invalid', 'password': 'invalid'})
assert response.status_code == 405

tests.name: test_login_form_get_boundary
preconditions: The Flask application is running in test mode.
actions: Send a GET request to /auth/login with a very large header.
expected: The response contains the login form HTML.
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()
large_header = {'X-Large-Header': 'x' * 10000}
response = client.get('/auth/login', headers=large_header)
assert response.status_code == 200
assert b'<form' in response.data
assert b'name="username"' in response.data
assert b'name="password"' in response.data
